title: A Machine Learning Framework for Stock Selection

data_binding.reason: shared benchmark data replaces the paper's native dataset and protocol

requirements: Chinese stock data for constructing labeled stock instances
Training dataset constructed from Chinese stock data ranging from 2012.08.08 to 2013.02.01
Testing dataset constructed from Chinese stock data ranging from 2013.02.04 to 2013.03.08
244 technical and fundamental features for each stock

dimensions.implication: The benchmark uses a frozen shared dataset rather than the paper's original data.
A changed information interval alters the empirical claim.
Only an explicitly named MethodCard model branch may enter the benchmark.
Shared features isolate model behavior but do not reproduce the paper's end-to-end pipeline.

paper_value.evaluation: Fixed chronological holdout statistical evaluation: train on Chinese stock data ranging from 2012.08.08 to 2013.02.01 and test on Chinese stock data ranging from 2013.02.04 to 2013.03.08. The selected result row is the Stacking model before GA feature selection.

dimensions.implication: The shared temporal split and metric definitions control comparability across methods.
Trading claims require matched cost and position rules; prediction-only metrics do not establish tradability.

paper_vs_run_delta.original_paper_hypothesis_reason: Shared benchmark data/features/splits differ from the native paper protocol; the original claim cannot be proved or disproved by this run.
paper_vs_run_delta.adapted_task_hypothesis_reason: The method beats the task-appropriate no-leakage baseline.
